order: Genericize the README's install instructions so they no longer assume the maintainer's own local paths. Replace the hardcoded local path in the install example with a placeholder environment variable, and add a POSIX clone-and-install snippet alongside it so non-maintainer users have a copy-pasteable path. Rename the internal project-name labels used in a couple of places to a neutral harness name, without breaking the uninstaller's existing loose-prefix fallback, which still needs to match the old markers for anything installed under the old name. Add a permissive open-source license file at the repository root and a corresponding license section in the README so the project's licensing terms are stated rather than implied.
claims: The install example now points at a placeholder environment variable instead of a hardcoded local path, with a POSIX clone-and-install snippet added beside it. Internal labels were renamed to a neutral name while the uninstaller's loose-prefix fallback was left in place so it still matches markers from installs under the old name. A permissive license file and a matching README section were added.
